in_marathi.name: Avishal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Peace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avishal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avishal is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'Lord of Peace'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'avishala', which means 'immutable', 'unshaken', 'unconquerable'. It is a powerful name that evokes a sense of calmness, stability, and strength.
